name: Mental Breakdown Minnesota 2021
information:
# The competition has been cancelled due to many COVID cases in the USA.

**We will not be holding the regular 3x3 Speedsolving event at this competition!**

There is a 20 person Competitor Limit for this competition. Please sign up early to ensure a spot.

Please read the "Waiting List" tab for additional information on registration for the competition.

# YOU MUST READ THE COVID SAFETY TAB PRIOR TO REGISTERING.
